title: Private City Tour of Houston 3-hr Sightseeing Tour
includes: Air Conditioned, fully covered vehicles designed for smaller groups which operate rain or shine.
(1) Free souvenir per every (2) people in your party.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
TRAVELER MUST PROVIDE PICKUP ADDRESS DURING BOOKING PROCESS. THIS INFORMATION IS REQUIRED FOR TOUR OPERATOR TO CONFIRM YOUR PICKUP.
Safety seats are required by law. Parent must provide safety seat for children requiring this.
Collapsible, non-motorized wheelchairs can be accommodated. Occupant must be able to board and exit without physical assistance from the driver.
Not recommended for travelers who cannot go without use of a restroom or cigarette for 2-hrs.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Book the best private tour in Houston with hotel pickup in air-conditioned vans. Explore multiple neighborhoods around the city with local guides to hear history, demographics, cool stories and fun facts as you cruise the leafy, tree lined streets of the elaborate River Oaks for the "Lifestyles of Rich & Famous" tour. 

Customize your private tour to focus on basics or specifics such as neighborhoods, universities, churches, murals or visit the best photo backgrounds, landscapes and skyline locations for memorable photos to document your Houston experience.
Enjoy effortless Houston sightseeing tours to the Museum District where you can end your tour to see Houston Zoo, Hermann Park or 1 of 21 museums. After touring, return to hotel or any location discovered during your tour.
*Downtown *Uptown Galleria *Midtown *EaDo *River Oaks *Museum District *West University *Historical Heights *Rice Village 
 Brochures, dining coupons and 1 Free souvenir per group are provided.
